macros.name: fmf
macros.doc: connects the vertices v1,v2,. . . with a line of style ⟨style⟩, using a set of options ⟨opt⟩ with (optional) value ⟨val⟩.

macros.name: fmfcmd
macros.doc: The \fmfcmd macro writes its argument into the METAFONT input file generated by feynMF.

macros.name: fmfdot
macros.doc: Draw a dot at the vertices given as arguments.

macros.name: fmffixed
macros.doc: \fmffixed{⟨dist⟩}{⟨v1⟩[,. . . ]} fixes the distance between subsequent vertices in the list ⟨v1⟩. . . to ⟨dist⟩.

macros.name: fmfforce
macros.doc: \fmfforce{⟨pos⟩}{⟨v1⟩[,. . . ]} forces the position ⟨pos⟩ of the vertices ⟨v1⟩. . . , bypassing and overwriting the automatic layout.

macros.name: fmfframe
macros.doc: puts an invisible frame of the given dimensions (measured in \unitlength) around ⟨box⟩.

macros.name: fmffreeze
macros.doc: By issuing a \fmffreeze after specifying a subgraph (skeleton), we can fix the location of the skeleton as if the other arcs were not there.

macros.name: fmfi
macros.doc: draws a line of style ⟨style⟩ on path ⟨p⟩.

macros.name: fmfiequ
macros.doc: Establish equality for the two arguments, i.e. \fmfiequ{lval}{rval} translates to lval=rval.

macros.name: fmfiset
macros.doc: Assign the second argument to the first, i.e. \fmfiset{lval}{rval} translates to lval:=rval.

macros.name: fmfiv
macros.doc: draws a vertex at position ⟨v⟩.

macros.name: fmfkeep
macros.doc: After saving a pointer with \fmfkeep{⟨name⟩} inside a fmfgraph or fmfgraph* environment, the diagram can be reused later by \fmfreuse{⟨name⟩}.

macros.name: fmfleft
macros.doc: \fmfleft{⟨v1⟩[,. . . ]} places the vertices in the comma separated list ⟨v1⟩,. . . equidistantly on a smooth path on the left side of the diagram.

macros.name: fmfpen
macros.doc: \fmfpen{⟨weight⟩} is used for changing the weight (i.e. thickness) of the lines.

macros.name: fmfpolyn
macros.doc: places the vertices ⟨v1⟩, ⟨v2⟩, . . . on the corners of a regular polygon.

macros.name: fmfreuse
macros.doc: After saving a pointer with \fmfkeep{⟨name⟩} inside a fmfgraph or fmfgraph* environment, the diagram can be reused later by \fmfreuse{⟨name⟩}.

macros.name: fmfrpolyn
macros.doc: places the vertices ⟨v1⟩, ⟨v2⟩, . . . on the corners of a regular polygon.

macros.name: fmfshift
macros.doc: \fmfshift{⟨dist⟩}{⟨v1⟩[,. . . ]} shifts the position of the vertices ⟨v1⟩. . . by ⟨dist⟩ from the automatic layout.

macros.name: fmfstopdisplay
macros.doc: \fmfstopdisplay will halt METAFONT everytime a graph is complete.

macros.name: fmfv
macros.doc: This is used for adding labels to a vertex and for specifying other decoration.

envs.name: fmfgraph
envs.doc: The fmfgraph environment contains the description of a single Feynman diagram which will be placed a the location of the environment.

envs.name: fmfgraph*
envs.doc: The fmfgraph environment contains the description of a single Feynman diagram which will be placed a the location of the environment.
